items.title: Legislative Day of 09/03/2026
items.description: POINT OF PERSONAL PRIVILEGE - Mr. Massie rose to a point of personal privilege. The Chair announced that it was made aware of the basis for the point of personal privilege and recognized Mr. Massie to proceed for one hour on his point of personal privilege.

items.title: Legislative Day of 09/03/2026
items.description: DEBATE - The House proceeded with debate on H.R. 9086.

items.title: Legislative Day of 09/03/2026
items.description: The House resolved itself into the Committee of the Whole House on the state of the Union for further consideration.
